name: Vibefy

apps.name: Vibefy Preview
apps.localizedDescription:
Create playlists, import public Spotify or YouTube playlists, and scan playlist QR codes from your computer. Connect YouTube to load your account playlists and save selected copies.

Listen together with Jam. Nearby desktop pairing requires Vibefy 0.4.80, Wi-Fi and confirmation on your phone; shared playback needs internet.

Playlist metadata stays on your device unless you choose to share or save it. Local playlists can be lost if you uninstall the app or clear its data.

Screenshots use demonstration playlists, with no personal account data.

Credits and licenses: https://github.com/Spinti1/Vibefy/blob/main/CREDITS.md. iOS audio resolution uses YouTubeKit (MIT); QR decoding uses jsQR (Apache-2.0).

versions.localizedDescription: Mobile preview with on-device audio-only YouTube playback: M4A/AAC streaming with artwork, without loading a video player. Includes nearby desktop pairing over Wi-Fi with phone confirmation, QR playlist imports, protected Google renewal, persistent playlist metadata and Jam controls. Local-network discovery is foreground-only; internet is required for shared playback. Provider restrictions still apply. Existing account and playlist data is retained. Background behavior depends on the device; physical-device validation remains ongoing. Android uses NewPipeExtractor (GPL-3.0-or-later); iOS uses YouTubeKit (MIT).

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Scan a playlist QR code from Vibefy on your computer. Images stay on your device.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Find this phone in Vibefy on your computer and approve shared playback over your Wi-Fi.
